body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units who can perceive you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units toward you or a visible enemy; when targeting yourself, choose any visible destination.

surges.html: The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or an ally within 3 units begins voluntary movement: ignore the first difficult space of that movement.
